segments.he: תַּנְיָא אִידַּךְ: רְקִיקִין הַבָּאִים בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָן, מֵבִיא לוֹג שֶׁמֶן וּמוֹשְׁחָן, וְחוֹזֵר וּמוֹשְׁחָן, עַד שֶׁיִּכְלֶה כׇּל שֶׁמֶן שֶׁבַּלּוֹג. רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן: מוֹשְׁחָן כְּמִין כִּי, וּשְׁאָר הַשֶּׁמֶן נֶאֱכָל לַכֹּהֲנִים.
segments.en: «It is taught» in «another» baraita: In the case of ten «wafers that come by themselves» as a meal offering baked in the oven, and not as part of another offering, he «brings a log of oil and smears them, and he again smears them» repeatedly «until all the oil in the log is finished. Rabbi Shimon ben Yehuda says in the name of Rabbi Shimon:» He «smears them» in a shape «similar» to the letter «chi, and the rest of the oil is eaten by the priests.»
